reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget my pills at home on work trips and a sachet fits in my tote. I would try one box to see if it works for travel, but I would not stock up at this price.
objection: $29.99 is double what I paid for Toplux 8 forms in a flash sale, and that bottle lasts 3 months. I'm paying a lot for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box price around $19.99 or a small trial pack, so I can test it on a couple of trips before I commit to a full box.
